name: docker_open5gs (herlesupreeth)
what_it_is: A Docker-based deployment framework for a complete 4G/5G open-source telecom network stack, integrating Open5GS core, IMS services (Kamailio/OpenSIPS/pyHSS), srsRAN radio simulators, and UERANSIM. Supports both RF-simulated (ZMQ) and over-the-air (SDR hardware) test scenarios across 19+ named deployment configurations.
measurement: Grafana dashboards for real-time network metrics
Prometheus metrics collection from core network functions
Web UI on port 9999 for Open5GS HSS subscriber state inspection
REST API on port 8080 (pyHSS) for IMS subscriber data queries
Telnet interface to OsmoHLR for HLR state inspection
configuration: MCC/MNC set via .env file (mobile country and network codes)
UE_IPV4_INTERNET and UE_IPV4_IMS for subscriber address pool ranges
AMF_IP, MME_IP, UPF_ADVERTISE_IP for multi-host split deployments
ZMQ vs SDR radio mode selectable per compose scenario
19+ named deployment scenarios covering 4G-only, 5G SA, IMS, ePDG, and hybrid topologies
modes: Single-host: all components on one machine using ZMQ RF simulation
Multi-host: radio access (srsRAN/UERANSIM) on separate host from core network
Over-the-air: real SDR hardware (Ettus USRP B210, LimeSDR Mini/USB) instead of ZMQ
IMS/VoLTE mode with Kamailio or OpenSIPS
constraints: Requires Ubuntu 22.04+ as the host OS
Requires Docker CE 22.0.5+ and Docker Compose 2.14+
UFW firewall must be disabled on the host
IP forwarding must be enabled on the host
CPU performance scaling (governor) must be enabled for stable radio simulation
IPv6 inside Docker is not supported
Over-the-air mode requires specific SDR hardware (Ettus USRP B210 or LimeSDR variant)
notable_absences: No built-in fault injection or chaos tooling
No packet capture / PCAP collection service in the compose stack
No automated test harness or CI-driven scenario runner
No support for IPv6 subscriber addressing inside containers
No O-RAN (O1/E2/A1) interface or RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) component
